title: Chapter 212 Four Major Families
content:
Chapter 212 Four Major Families

The visitor is not kind.

Xiao Jing looked at Lu Daosheng in front of him with a serious expression, and his hands were already trembling slightly.

At this time, Xiao Chen hurriedly said, "Lord of Huang City, please calm down."

"how?"

Lu Daosheng looked at Xiao Chen.

Lu Daosheng still has a little bit of good feelings for Xiao Chen, after all, this guy is very good at speaking.

Xiao Chen took a few steps forward and bowed to Lu Daosheng.

"Lord of Huangcheng, it is a forced one for me to do this. I think you should already know that my Xiao clan is in a state of embarrassment now."

Speaking of this, a trace of sadness appeared on Xiao Chen's face.

The same is true for Xiao Jing and Xiao Xuanmu behind him.

But when he heard this, Lu Daosheng had no expression on his face.

"What do you think of your Xiao clan? What do you have to do with me? What do you want to morally kidnap me?"

As soon as these words came out, Xiao Chen's face suddenly looked awkward.

"Lord of Huang City, you misunderstood what I mean,"

"What do you mean?"

Lu Daosheng looked at Xiao Chen like this and had to give him an explanation.

Otherwise, he wouldn't give up.

Looking at Lu Daosheng's serious expression, Xiao Chen looked at Xiao Jing behind him, and then at Xiao Xuanmu.

Finally, Xiao Chen took a deep breath and said solemnly to Lu Daosheng: "Lord of Huangcheng, I, Xiao clan, are willing to join Huangcheng and become a member of Huangcheng."

As early as in the Desolate City, Xiao Chen mentioned that Xiao Chen and Xiao Xuanmu joined the Desolate City.

It’s a pity that Lu Daosheng looked down on the two of them at that time, so the matter was left alone.

Later, Xiao Chen proposed to dedicate everything to the Xiao clan to express the sincerity of the Xiao clan.

Huangcheng then sent Lu Xue to help them rescue the Xiao clan.

Although it has not been successful, it has also been done.

After that, there was a bet between Xiao Chen and Lu Xue.

At that time, they didn't expect that they would lose to Lu Xue when they were beaten to death, otherwise they would definitely not have suppressed the entire Xiao clan.

Therefore, whether it is Xiao Chen, Xiao Xuanmu, or the rest of the Xiao clan, they do not agree with this matter.

But there was no way. Xiao Chen had already agreed to Lu Xue verbally, which led to the Xiao clan's refusal to admit his conviction and chose the most wrong decision.

And now, Lu Daosheng himself has arrived in person, and they know that they can no longer rely on this matter.

Looking at Xiao Chen and the others who were looking down in front of him and waiting for his response, Lu Daosheng did not speak, but looked up at the hazy mountain in front of him.

For a moment, Lu Daosheng narrowed his eyes slightly.

"interesting."

Lu Daosheng suddenly smiled and then looked at Xiao Chen and the others again.

"No need."

"What?"

Xiao Chen and the others looked up suddenly, not hearing clearly.

Lu Daosheng said again: "I said, there is no need, you Xiao clan, I don't see it so much."

These words made Xiao Jing and others a little stunned.

When was the dignified ancient Xiao clan so looked down upon?

But the few people did not dare to get angry and had to hold this aggrievance in their hearts.

When he was in place, Lu Daosheng also saw that the few people were dissatisfied.

What's the use if you don't accept it? This is the fact.

As long as you think about it and give yourself some time, you can build a force that is not weaker than this Xiao clan.

Since the Xiao clan is so ignorant, why should I ask for the other party?

At this moment, the Xiao clan didn't know what great opportunity he and others had missed.

And at this moment, Lu Daosheng suddenly said, "You have been watching the show in secret. Why? Are you shameful?"

As soon as these words were said, Xiao Jing and his men's faces suddenly changed, and they quickly looked around.

The next moment, a loud laugh came from the void.

"I didn't expect that there were even a strong man like you in this fairyland."

There was a click.

The space suddenly cracked, and three powerful figures slowly walked out of the crack.

Two men and one woman.

Seeing these three figures, Xiao Jing immediately exclaimed: "It's you!"

Lu Daosheng turned his head and looked at Xiao Chen.

"Do you recognize it?"

Xiao Chen nodded and said with a ugly expression: "These three are the elders of the Ye clan, the elders of the Chu clan and the elders of the Xie clan."

"And the three tribes of Ye, Chu, and Xie are the ancient families that are as famous as our Xiao tribe!"

"Four major families?"

Lu Daosheng immediately looked at the three figures standing proudly in the void with interest.

The three of them have the same cultivation level, and they are all in the late stage of the Ninth Level of the Immortal Emperor Realm. Judging from their aura, they seem to be stronger than the ordinary Earth Immortal Emperor Realm.

At this time, the great elder of the Leaf Clan in the void suddenly burst into laughter.

"The ancient Xiao clan? Is it as famous as us? Do you think your Xiao clan is still worthy of being as famous as us now?"

On the side, the elder of the Chu clan also nodded with a smile.

"I hope you have some self-knowledge. If you know the truth, just leave the fairyland. With the current strength of your Xiao clan, you are no longer qualified to be called the ancient family."

Hearing this, Xiao Jing and the other two looked extremely ugly.

It’s a pity that the three of them are obviously not the opponents of the elders of these three tribes.

Except for Xiao Jing who is in the middle stage of the ninth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm, Xiao Chen and the others are in the early stage of the Ninth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

But at this moment, the people of the three tribes seemed to be afraid of something and had no intention of taking action.

At this time, the people of the Xiao clan finally noticed the abnormality here and rushed towards it.

"Elder! You guys,"

"Huh?! Ye clan, Chu clan, and Xie clan, what do you want to do!"

"You dare to openly break into my Xiao tribe territory. Do you want to die?"

The powerful people of the Xiao clan stared at the people of the three clans with anger, and their aura kept leaking out and their momentum was surging.

Seeing this, the people of the three tribes smiled disdainfully.

"Just you guys?"

boom!

Suddenly, a powerful pressure surged out of the three people.

The pressure of the three late-stage strong men in the Immortal Emperor realm suddenly changed the world of the Xiao clan, and the void rumbling, and the entire Xiao clan suddenly felt like the end of the world.

At this moment, the gap suddenly appeared.

Just because the three tribes sent one person separately, the Xiao tribe couldn't bear it anymore.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng suddenly became a little suspicious.

Is this Xiao clan really an ancient family?

Facing the same ancient family, even if they decline, there will be no such a big gap.

"presumptuous!"

Just when the Xiao clan looked a little desperate, an old but extremely powerful voice sounded from the depths of the Xiao clan.

The next moment, a terrifying aura surged towards here, and the people of the three tribes changed their faces.

Everyone looked in that direction.

I saw an old man dragging his elderly body slowly towards here, as if he would die at any time in the next moment, but the terrifying aura came from this old body.

"Senior Xiao Sheng!!"

When most people in the Xiao clan saw the old man, they looked a little confused and obviously did not recognize him.

But Xiao Jing directly called out the old man's name.

It is the only peak strong man in the Immortal Emperor Realm who is still here in the Xiao clan.

The next step to the true peak is to be above the Immortal Emperor Realm.
